text:
incbot: PAGE: High 5xx rate detected for dedicated pool `argus-prod-pool` (region: us-west-2). Threshold breached: 8% 5xx over 1m. Pager: maya (oncall).
maya (oncall): acknowledged — joining bridge. tagging @adrian @kai. what's current customer impact? :rotating_light:
adrian (eng-runtime): seeing a spike in `inference_errors` from tenant `argus-inc` on node g4-12-11. KV cache eviction errors followed by OOM-heavy retries. logs:
```
2026-03-16T21:12:03Z ERROR kv_cache: eviction_failed key=auth_state tenant=argus-inc err=ENOMEM
2026-03-16T21:12:04Z WARN request: retrying request id=0x7f2a status=503
```
rachel (acct-mgr): customer reported increased latency and some failed calls to their product ingestion pipeline — they flagged for exec. I DM'd them that we're on it.
kai (sre): isolating noisy tenant now — applying pod affinity to shadow it off the shared pool. command I'm running:
```
kubectl label pod -l tenant=argus-inc argus-noise=isolated --overwrite
kubectl patch deployment argus-prod --type='json' -p='[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/metadata/labels/isolated","value":"true"}]'
```
adrian (eng-runtime): pushed a temporary routing rule to send `argus-inc` to pre-warmed dedicated slice `argus-dedicated-2` and enabled reduced kv cache retention (ttl=30s). fallback policy -> model-variant `gpt-small-q4` for warm start. This should cut OOM surface.
ops-bot: Route update applied — 1 host in `argus-dedicated-2` warmed. Autoscaler: +2 replicas requested.
maya (oncall): can you confirm error rates after move? pulling metrics.
adrian (eng-runtime): error rate down to 0.9% and p95 latency back to SLA range for non-impacted tenants. `argus-inc` still has some retries while model warmup completes.
sam (customer-success): customer on call says they see improvement but want details about root cause and next steps. asking for exec summary and whether we'll propose a credit.
maya (oncall): quick postmortem notes (for RCA draft):
- incident start: 2026-03-16T21:12:03Z (incbot)
- impact: `argus-inc` requests returned 5xx/503 intermittently for ~11m during noisy tenant eviction and routing switchover
- immediate mitigation: isolated tenant + route to pre-warmed dedicated slice + downgraded model variant to reduce mem pressure
- probable root cause: combination of aggressive KV cache growth from a customer-side workload pattern (large streaming prefix windows) and a regression in eviction path introduced in runtime release 1.8.2
rachel (acct-mgr): customers asking for estimated credits and timeline for RCA. suggested credit = 5% of monthly committed spend for the affected window. thoughts?
kai (sre): agree as a baseline. need internal confirmation from finance. Also add action item to add tenant throttling guard and a runtime safe-eviction fallback in 1.8.3.
adrian (eng-runtime): I'll open an internal PR referencing the failing eviction path and add unit tests. linking draft commit: https://git.internal/repo/eviction-fix/PR-451
maya (oncall): creating the incident timeline doc now and pushing an initial RCA draft into docs/incidents/6134567890-argus-rca-draft.md — tagging @adrian @kai for tech review and @rachel @sam for customer-facing language.
sam (customer-success): I'll draft an exec email. key points: quick mitigation summary, tangible credits proposal, remediation plan + ETA (fix in 1.8.3, ETA 2 weeks), and offer a remediation review call. sending first cut by EOD.
rachel (acct-mgr): please include: apology, impact window, what we did immediately, what we will do to prevent recurrence, and proposed credit. I'll coordinate approvals.
adrian (eng-runtime): quick note: add a follow-up to run a targeted chaos test for KV pressure in dedicated slices — to validate eviction under load.
maya (oncall): post-incident actions assigned:
- adrian: PR + unit tests (target release 1.8.3)
- kai: add tenant throttling guard & run chaos test
- sam/rachel: customer exec email + credit proposal and approvals
- ops: update runbook for noisy-tenant isolation
ops-bot: Incident closed (manual) by maya (oncall). Severity set to Sev2. Link to timeline: https://incidents.internal/6134567890
rachel (acct-mgr): thanks team — I'll wait for the RCA doc link and the credit ask. prepping an exec version once PR has a patch note.
adrian (eng-runtime): uploaded initial technical appendix to the RCA doc (stack traces + perf counters). Please review before we send to customer.
sam (customer-success): first draft email posted to thread for quick review:
"Dear Argus team, we're sorry for the disruption on 2026-03-16. We identified a memory-eviction regression combined with an unusual workload pattern from your tenant that caused transient failures. We mitigated by isolating traffic and routing to a pre-warmed slice; full fix is targeted for release 1.8.3 in ~2 weeks. We propose a 5% credit for the billing period covering the incident window. Would you like a follow-up call with engineering?"
maya (oncall): looks good. minor suggestion: add concrete timestamp range and include contact for escalation. once agreed, rachel please send.
rachel (acct-mgr): will finalize and send in the next 60m after legal OK. tagging finance.
incbot: NOTE: follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-18 to confirm patch release and credit applied.
(End of thread)
